blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — United Pilipino Against Crime and Corruption (UPACC) Chairperson Pyra Nucum Lucas and four other individuals face an “destructive arson” complaint before the Department of Justice (DOJ) for allegedly intentionally burning a couple’s newly-built home in Capas, Tarlac. Complainants Emil and Analyn Cadiang — the couple who filed the complaint against Lucas, Arthur Aquino, and three other unidentified individuals — said the supposed destructive arson took place on June 28 last year. Analyn asserted in their affidavit that she personally saw Lucas and another individual destroying their house in Barangay Bueno before this was eventually burned. READ: Senior citizens […]...
